source.title: Complete solution to open problems on exponential augmented Zagreb index of chemical trees

trace.notes: Normalized one URL input. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/8030173 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so zbMATH was treated as a resolver rather than a readable technical source.

zbMATH REST API identified document 8030173 as DOI 10.1016/j.amc.2024.128983 with title Complete solution to open problems on exponential augmented Zagreb index of chemical trees, by Sourav Mondal and Kinkar Chandra Das, Applied Mathematics and Computation 482, article 128983 (2024).
Crossref confirmed the DOI and exposed Elsevier TDM links for PII S0096300324004442, but those links require Elsevier article API access and did not yield a readable full-text artifact in this run.
OpenAlex returned open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false for the same DOI.

Bounded exact-work search inspected candidate pages for the exact title, DOI, and PII. ScienceDirect was the publisher landing page and did not provide readable full text; SKKU Pure, IDEAS/RePEc, EconPapers, and ResearchGate exposed only metadata, abstracts, request-full-text pages, or explicit subscriber-only/full-text-restricted links. No candidate was accepted as a readable primary source.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with metadata_only candidate pages. Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source for extraction without relying on abstracts, citation metadata, search snippets, or resolver records.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/8030173.json and outputs/latest.json.
